- **Duplicati version**: 2.0.5.110

## Description
<!-- Describe the issue that you are experiencing below. -->
When browsing for files to restore, the "wait" animated icon (while the tree is loading) s now not shown properly.  Looks like it's the wrong scale perhaps.

I first noticed this when I installed 2.0.5.110, but it's possible it was present in earlier builds.

evidence.eventual_fix_title: Fix appearance of loading icon in file restore tree
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
Fix appearance of loading icon in file restore tree

When we introduced the high resolution icons in pull request #4214, somehow the loading icon in the file restore tree stopped appearing correctly.  Adding an explicit size in the CSS appears to fix the issue.

This fixes #4294.
